picks.editorial_note: An AI model (Omnii) designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a landmark proof that generative AI can produce functional biological therapeutics, not just predict them.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: ARPA-H's up to $53 million award to an MIT-led team to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives is a substantial federal bet on AI-driven chemistry solving a major agricultural and public-health problem.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena — from granular flow to protein folding — under one deep-learning architecture, a significant step toward general-purpose physical world models.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's machine-learning imaging technique independently confirmed the iconic Event Horizon Telescope image of the M87 black hole in a Nature publication, giving AI methods a validated role in fundamental astrophysics.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a national-security-linked scandal destabilizes leadership at the company most central to the global AI buildout, with ripple effects for AI research funding and hardware supply chains.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint lab, pairs a major research university with a leading embodied-AI hardware company — a concrete step toward commercializing academic robotics research.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to transfer AI and robotics research into sovereign industrial applications reflects Europe's push to build independent AI industrial capacity, spanning physical AI, agentic AI, and cybersecurity.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: Texas Tech's additional $19 million from the state's Semiconductor Innovation Fund will build an AI-integrated computing cluster for chip R&D, reinforcing a state-level strategy to tie AI infrastructure to domestic semiconductor manufacturing.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2 million NIST award to build a Digital Twin Technology Lab combining AI, robotics, and HPC for semiconductor manufacturing supports both industrial capacity and workforce training in a strategically critical sector.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon's 'Workspace Models' give robots a new memory mechanism to recall past observations without costly re-sensing, a practical advance toward more capable and efficient autonomous robots.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills
